content.value: ‘A single-phase transformer has 500 turns in the primary and 1200 turns in the secondary. The cross-sectional area of the core is 80 sq.cm. If the primary winding is connected to a 50Hz supply at 500V, calculate (i) peak flux-density and (ii) voltage induced in the secondary.
